test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

P. an unparalleled popularity

Q. the Lotus Temple has always enjoyed

R. as shown by its pre-dominance in literature and art

S. throughout the length and breadth of India from the earliest times down to the present day,
solution:
The correct answer is **"QPSR."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence talks about the Lotus Temple and its popularity in India.
